summary: Your annual physical and flu shot on June 2, 2026, were both covered at 100% as preventive care. The plan paid the full allowed amounts. You owe $0. The provider wrote off the difference between their billed charges and the plan's allowed rates.

actions: Keep this EOB for your records.

If you receive a bill from the provider for any amount, contact the provider's billing office and refer them to this EOB—preventive services are covered at 100%, and CO write-offs are the provider's responsibility.
If the provider continues to bill you, contact your plan's member services.
